source.evidence: Pinned Atomify df3afbb8644116bb3d9374088e23741e9ce5905c. Input data SHA256 614b14f070cdf450c5bd91f3ebe3d2a593864995d6176e8cdc50ea2ab4932d21. Selected LAMMPS annealed/minimized data SHA256 24cc64c727847c625391f14b4884dd2b732a230e9c58f2f8b51ed60b2e6c99ae. All 24,050 atoms retained in one connected component, 46,452 displayed Si–C bonds.

notes: Cancelled by the user before printing, in favor of a nanoporous silica model. No printer upload or print start occurred. The preparation slice was deliberately terminated; its worker reported signal termination (exit -15), not a slicer-completed result. The attached images visualize the relaxed atomic coordinates, not a sliced plate. The cutaway is for inspection only: the prepared candidate retained all 24,050 atoms and the entire core. LAMMPS annealing/cooling and both minimizations completed. The repaired mesh passed independent readback, but no completed slice or accepted toolpath was produced. No print time or filament consumption was measured. Geometric volume gave an unused model-only PLA estimate of about 370 g at 1.24 g/cm³; supports and purge were additional and unestimated. Printed strength and PVA dissolution were never verified.
